title: Model & Route Telemetry Canvas — compact inspector + correlated cost lanes
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design a compact but powerful telemetry canvas that surfaces per-model and per-route performance signals (latency, throughput, token metrics) and tightly correlates them with cost lanes and rollout events. The goal is a single inspector users can open from any route or model page to: 1) quickly triage performance regressions, 2) compare model variants over identical query workloads, and 3) understand token-driven cost contributors across time windows. This ticket covers: canvas layout, small-multiples and sparklines, detailed chart specs for distribution and waterfall charts, event marker treatment for rollouts/canaries, responsive/compact mode for narrow panels, and an accessible color palette for signal severity.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype with 3 canvas states: overview, focused metric, and full-detail waterfall
Chart specs (series types, aggregation windows, units) documented and reviewed by backend/metrics team
Prototype demonstrates event markers for rollout, fallback, and autoscale events with hover-to-reveal metadata
Accessibility contrast passes AA for all key signal colors; keyboard navigation supported in compact inspector
Implementation checklist created for frontend/telemetry SRE with sliceable queries and suggested aggregation indices
design_notes: Core UX idea: present coarse-grained trends in the canvas header (latency P50/P95, throughput rps, tokens/sec, cost estimate per-minute) with inline mini-sparklines. Below the header, offer two lanes: (A) time-series lanes (stacked token types, throughput, latency series overlay) and (B) analytic lane with distribution histogram (latency distribution), waterfall for token timing, and error-rate sparkline. Key interactions: time window sync across lanes, compare mode that overlays another model/variant for same window, drill into specific request samples (opens microtrace in new panel), and pin event markers (rollout start, config change). Compact mode collapses header and stacks a single combined chart with toggle to open full analytic lane.
chart_specs: Latency series: line + area for P50 (solid) and P95 (dashed) overlay. Aggregation: 1m buckets default, selectable to 10s/1m/5m/1h. Y-axis units: ms (log scale option for wide distributions).
Throughput: bar-step series showing requests-per-second (rps). Aggregation: same window as latency. Secondary y-axis where needed.
Token throughput: stacked area broken down by token source (prompt, response, cache-hit). Units: tokens/sec and total tokens per window. Enable numeric display and percent breakdown on hover.
Latency distribution: histogram with configurable bin count (default 50). Overlay percentile markers (P50, P75, P90, P95, P99) with popovers showing sample counts and example prompts.

Token waterfall: waterfall chart showing time-to-first-token, time-between-tokens (median & IQR), and tail-latencies for KV cache hits vs cold paths. Allow selecting a request sample to surface microtrace link.

Cost lane: derived metric combining token counts, model unit-cost-per-token, and serving-time cost to produce an estimated cost-per-minute heatmap. Allow toggling model pricing profiles (hosted vs dedicated).
Event markers: vertical markers with color-coded types (deploy, canary, autoscale, fallback). Hover reveals metadata: author, PR link, rollout percentage, and linked incident if any.

Color palette: neutral background + semantic signal set: success (#2ECC71), info (#4AA3FF), warning (#FFA94D), danger (#F35A5A), baseline metrics (#6B7280). All colors checked for AA contrast with white/black where used.

Data retention and sampling: default show last 72h with 1m granularity; for >72h auto-aggregate to 5m or 1h. Provide 'dense sampling' toggle for debug sessions that retains 10s granularity for last 1h.
Annotations: free-text notes pinned to timeline; users can add comments linked to a rollout and share a permalink to the canvas view (time window + compare selection).
review_feedback: PM (Luis Navarro): prefer cost lane be opt-in; don't surface estimated dollars by default for privacy/enterprise customers. Suggest toggled visibility per-org.
Eng (Samira Kline): confirm required backend aggregations; recommend precomputed p95 and histogram shards to avoid heavy on-the-fly aggregations. Also ask for event marker API contract.
SRE (Marcus Holt): add guidance for sampling and retention to avoid query spikes on high-cardinality routes. Suggest index on (route_id, bucket_ts).
Accessibility (Nina Rao): request high-contrast alternate theme option and keyboard-focus order for interactive chart tooltips.
Design review (Avery Chen): prototype should include compact inspector interactions in mobile narrow-width mockups to validate stacking behavior.
decisions: Default time window set to 24h in explorer links, 72h in canvas to support cross-shift triage
Cost lane disabled by default for customers with privacy flag; opt-in at org-level
Latency histogram and token waterfall will be client-side rendered from pre-aggregated metric endpoints to limit backend load
Charting library: evaluate switching to internal high-performance renderer (canvas-based) for waterfall and histograms to support dense sampling
tasks: Handoff: provide detailed spec and example telemetry query shapes to engineering (assignee: Samira Kline)
Accessibility pass for color palette and keyboard interactions (assignee: Nina Rao)
Prototype polish: add mobile stacking and compare-mode toggles (assignee: Priya Patel)
Backend: proto API for event markers and precomputed pXX shards (assignee: Marcus Holt)
Create implementation checklist in Confluence and link to PRD (assignee: Avery Chen)
Metrics QA: validate chart values against raw logs for a 72h window on two high-volume routes
